DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13207-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13207-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 相談は何件ご希望ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13207-02-001-SHARED-01.translation: How many matters would you like to book consultations for?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13207-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13207-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 夫と二人で来るので、二件予約したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13207-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 来庁人数を理由に二件予約したいと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13207-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: My husband and I will come together, so I would like to book two consultations.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13207-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that you want two bookings because two people will attend. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13207-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13207-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: お二人がそれぞれ別の相談をされますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13207-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: Will each of you discuss a different matter?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13207-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13207-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 相談は一件だけです。私の申請について夫にも説明を聞いてもらいたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13207-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 二人で同じ一件の相談をすることを明確にする。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13207-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: There is only one matter. I would like my husband to hear the explanation about my application too.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13207-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Clarify that two people will discuss the same single matter. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13207-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13207-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: では、相談件数は一件ですね。ご本人のお名前で予約を進めますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13207-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: Then there is one consultation matter. Shall we proceed with a booking in your own name?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13207-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13207-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: はい、私の名前でお願いします。夫は同席者として伝えたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13207-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 本人の名前で予約し夫を同席者として伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13207-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: Yes, in my name, please. I would like to mention my husband as someone attending with me.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13207-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Book in your own name and list your husband as an accompanying person. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13207-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13207-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 同席できるかは相談内容によって確認が必要です。ご本人だけに伺う内容があってもよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13207-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: Whether he can attend needs checking according to the subject. Is it all right if there are things we need to ask you alone?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13207-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13207-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: はい、その場合は夫に外で待ってもらいます。同席を希望していることだけ記録してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13207-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 本人のみの聞き取りにも応じる意思を示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13207-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: Yes. In that case, I will have my husband wait outside. Please only record that I would like him to attend.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13207-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Show willingness to answer questions alone too. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13207-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13207-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 承知しました。候補日はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13207-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: Understood. Do you have any preferred dates?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13207-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13207-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 火曜日の午後が希望です。空いている時間と当日必要なものを教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13207-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 希望時間帯と持参物の確認を頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13207-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: I would prefer Tuesday afternoon. Please tell me the available times and what to bring on the day.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13207-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Ask about your preferred time period and what to bring. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13207-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13207-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 空き枠と持参物を確認します。同席の可否についても担当窓口から案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13207-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: We will check available slots and required items. The responsible desk will also explain whether your husband can attend.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13207-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13207-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 会計がお済みでしたら、こちらの書類をお受け取りください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13207-03-001-SHARED-01.translation: If you have finished paying, please collect these documents here.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13207-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13207-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。提出先の欄が会社名になっていますが、今回は学校に出す書類です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13207-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 学校用の書類に会社名があることを指摘する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13207-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: Thank you. The submission destination field has a company name, but this document is for a school this time.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13207-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Point out that a school document has a company name. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13207-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13207-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 診断内容ではなく、提出先の欄についてのご相談ですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13207-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: Your question concerns the submission destination field, not the diagnosis, correct?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13207-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13207-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: はい、内容の判断を変えてほしいのではありません。宛先だけ確認したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13207-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 診断内容ではなく宛先の確認だと明確にする。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13207-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: Yes. I am not asking to change the medical judgment. I only want to check the addressee.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13207-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Clarify that you are checking the addressee, not the diagnosis. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13207-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13207-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 以前の申込用紙には会社名があります。今回もその用紙を使われましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13207-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: The previous application form has a company name. Did you use that form this time too?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13207-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13207-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 以前の控えを参考に書いたので、会社名を残してしまったかもしれません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13207-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 以前の控えを参考にした経緯を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13207-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: I referred to the old copy while writing, so I may have left the company name in it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13207-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Explain how you used an old copy as a reference. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13207-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13207-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 発行担当に確認します。こちらで直せるか判断するまで、書類に書き込まないでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13207-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: I will check with the issuing staff. Please do not write on the document until they decide whether it can be corrected here.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13207-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13207-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: わかりました。自分で線を引かずにこのままお渡しします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13207-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 書類を自分で修正せず渡すことを伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13207-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: Understood. I will not cross it out myself; I will give it to you as it is.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13207-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say that you will hand over the document without correcting it yourself. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13207-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13207-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 学校の正式な名称がわかるものをお持ちですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13207-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: Have you brought anything showing the school's full official name?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13207-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13207-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 提出案内を持っています。名称と提出期限を一緒に確認していただけますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13207-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 学校の案内を示して名称と期限の確認を頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13207-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: I have the submission instructions. Could you check the name and submission deadline together?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13207-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Show the school instructions and ask to check the name and deadline. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13207-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13207-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 案内と書類をお預かりして、修正方法と受け取り時期を担当に確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13207-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: We will take the instructions and document and ask the staff member how to correct it and when you can collect it.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13207-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13207-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: なくされた物を教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13207-04-001-SHARED-01.translation: Please tell me what you lost.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13207-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13207-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: この写真です。手帳に貼ってありました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13207-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 写真を示して手帳に貼っていたことを伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13207-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: This photo. It was pasted in my planner.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13207-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Show the photo and say it was pasted in your planner. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13207-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13207-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 写真そのものがなくなりましたか。それとも手帳をなくしましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13207-04-001-SHARED-03.translation: Did you lose the photo itself, or did you lose the planner?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13207-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13207-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 手帳ごとです。写真は中に貼ってあるもので、今見せているのは別に保存していた画像です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13207-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 紛失したのは手帳全体で画像は別保存だと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13207-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: The whole planner. The photo is pasted inside, and what I am showing you now is an image saved separately.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13207-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that the whole planner is missing and this image was saved separately. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13207-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13207-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 手帳の外側の特徴はわかりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13207-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: Do you know the planner's external features?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13207-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13207-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 紺色で、角に小さな星のシールがあります。名前は外に書いていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13207-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 手帳の外観を具体的に説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13207-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: It is navy blue with a small star sticker on a corner. My name is not written on the outside.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13207-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Describe the planner's appearance specifically. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13207-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13207-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 最後に手帳を見たのはいつ、どこですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13207-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: When and where did you last see the planner?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13207-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13207-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 昨夜、自宅で予定を書いたときです。今朝のバスで開こうとして、ないことに気付きました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13207-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 最後に見た場所と紛失に気付いた場所を分ける。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13207-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: Last night at home when I wrote my plans. I realized it was missing when I tried to open it on the bus this morning.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13207-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Distinguish the last-seen location from where you noticed the loss. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13207-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13207-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 最後に見た場所と気付いた場所は別ですね。中には何が入っていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13207-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: So the last-seen location and where you noticed are different. What is inside?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13207-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13207-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 自分の連絡先を書いた紙があります。写真には家族も写っているので、人前に広げず説明したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13207-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 中の連絡先と家族写真の扱いの希望を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13207-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: A paper with my contact information. My family is also in the photo, so I would like to explain without spreading it out in public.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13207-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Explain the contact information inside and your preference for handling the family photo. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13207-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13207-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。手帳の外観、最後に確認した場所と時刻、中の写真の扱いの希望を記録し、手帳全体の紛失として受け付けます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13207-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. We will record the planner's appearance, where and when you last confirmed it, and your wishes about the photo inside, and accept this as loss of the whole planner.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13207-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13207-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: どのような受け取りをご希望ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13207-05-001-SHARED-01.translation: How would you like to collect it?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13207-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13207-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: コードを読んだので、この窓口に変更できていると思います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13207-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: コードを読んで受取場所が変わったと思ったことを伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13207-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: I scanned the code, so I think it has been changed to this counter.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13207-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say that you thought scanning the code changed the collection point. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13207-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13207-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 読み取った後に、受取場所を選んで申し込みを送信されましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13207-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: After scanning, did you choose the collection point and submit the request?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13207-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13207-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: いいえ、案内のページを開いただけです。窓口はまだ選んでいません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13207-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 案内ページを開いただけで未送信だと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13207-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: No, I only opened the information page. I have not selected a counter yet.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13207-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that you only opened the guide page and have not submitted anything. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13207-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13207-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: では、変更が完了したとは確認できません。不在票を見せていただけますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13207-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: Then we cannot confirm the change is complete. May I see the missed-delivery notice?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13207-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13207-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: こちらです。今どこで保管されているか先に調べてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13207-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 不在票を示して現在の保管場所を聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13207-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: Here it is. Please find out where it is currently being kept first.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13207-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Show the missed-delivery notice and ask the current storage location. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13207-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13207-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 担当に確認します。ここで受け取れない場合、どうされますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13207-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: I will check with the staff member. What will you do if you cannot collect it here?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13207-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13207-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 自宅への再配達を検討します。仕事が終わった後に受け取れる時間帯を知りたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13207-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 窓口受取が難しい場合の再配達時間帯を聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13207-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: I will consider home redelivery. I want to know what slots would let me receive it after work.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13207-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ask about redelivery slots if counter collection is difficult. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13207-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13207-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 受付できる時間帯と申し込み方法を確認します。決まったら完了画面も確かめてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13207-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: We will check available times and how to apply. Once decided, please check the completion screen too.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13207-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13207-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: はい、案内を開いただけで終えず、申し込みの結果を確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13207-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 申し込み結果まで確認する意思を示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13207-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: Yes. I will not finish merely by opening the guide; I will confirm the result of the request.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13207-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Show your intent to confirm the request result. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13207-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13207-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 確認できた保管状況と手続きをご案内します。まだ完了していない手続きを重ねて申し込まないよう、一緒に確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13207-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: We will explain the confirmed storage status and procedure. Let us check together so you do not submit duplicate requests for an unfinished procedure.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13207-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13207-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: カードの紛失についてのご相談ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13207-06-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you asking about a lost card?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13207-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13207-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。カードが見当たらず、同じ店の金額が二つ表示されています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13207-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: カード紛失と同額の二つの表示を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13207-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. I cannot find my card, and two amounts from the same shop are displayed.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13207-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Report the lost card and two displays of the same amount. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13207-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13207-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 紛失の対応と、表示内容の確認を分けて伺います。カードの種類がわかるものはありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13207-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: We will ask about handling the loss separately from checking the display. Do you have anything identifying the card type?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13207-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13207-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 契約の控えがあります。この銀行のカードですが、停止の連絡先を確認したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13207-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 契約の控えを示して停止の連絡先を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13207-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: I have a copy of the contract. It is this bank's card, and I want to confirm the contact for blocking it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13207-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Show the contract copy and confirm the contact for stopping the card. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13207-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13207-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 控えを確認して担当をご案内します。二つの表示には、どのような文字がありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13207-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: We will check the copy and direct you to the staff member. What words accompany the two displayed entries?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13207-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13207-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 一つは確定、もう一つは未確定です。二回払ったと決めつけず、状態を確認したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13207-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 確定と未確定を区別して状態確認を頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13207-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: One is finalized and the other pending. I want to check the statuses without assuming I paid twice.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13207-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Distinguish finalized from pending and ask for a status check. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13207-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13207-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 承知しました。ご自身で利用した日時と金額を教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13207-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: Understood. Please tell us when you used it and for how much.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13207-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13207-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 昨日の夕方に千二百円を一度使いました。ほかに心当たりのない利用も含めて確認したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13207-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 自分が利用した日時と金額を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13207-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: I used it once yesterday evening for twelve hundred yen. I would like to check for other transactions I do not recognize too.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13207-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Explain the date, time, and amount you used yourself. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13207-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13207-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 利用明細を担当と確認します。端末をお借りして操作する必要はありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13207-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: We will check the statement with the staff member. We do not need to borrow and operate your device.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13207-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13207-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 私が画面を開いて該当欄を示します。暗証番号は読み上げずに進めたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13207-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 自分で画面を示し暗証番号を読み上げない意思を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13207-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will open the screen myself and show the relevant fields. I would like to proceed without reading my PIN aloud.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13207-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that you will show the screen yourself and not read the PIN aloud. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13207-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13207-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: その方法で確認しましょう。紛失時の対応を先に案内し、表示の状態は担当が調べます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13207-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: Let us check that way. We will first explain what to do about the loss, and the staff member will investigate the displayed statuses.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13207-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13207-07-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: お持ちの商品について、どのような状態ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13207-07-001-SHARED-01.translation: What is the condition of the products you brought?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13207-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13207-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 牛乳の容器がぬれていて、外側から洗剤のようなにおいがします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13207-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 牛乳容器のぬれと洗剤に似たにおいを伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13207-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: The milk container is wet, and the outside smells like detergent.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13207-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Report the milk container's wetness and detergent-like smell. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13207-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13207-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 同じ袋に、ほかの商品を入れていましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13207-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: Did you have any other products in the same bag?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13207-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13207-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 洗剤も入れていました。牛乳が漏れたと思いましたが、洗剤のふたの周りもぬれています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13207-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 同じ袋の洗剤もぬれており原因は未確認だと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13207-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: Detergent too. I thought the milk had leaked, but it is also wet around the detergent lid.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13207-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that the detergent in the same bag is wet too and the cause is unconfirmed. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13207-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13207-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 飲んだり開けたりしていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13207-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: Have you drunk any or opened either one?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13207-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13207-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: いいえ、どちらも使っていません。においの原因を確かめようとして味見もしていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13207-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 開封も味見もしていないことを伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13207-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: No, I have not used either. I have not tasted it to try to identify the smell either.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13207-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say that you have neither opened nor tasted anything. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13207-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13207-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 購入時の状態や持ち運びについて教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13207-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please explain their condition at purchase and how you carried them.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13207-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13207-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 会計後に同じ袋で自宅まで運びました。いつぬれたかはわかりません。レシートはあります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13207-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 持ち運びの経緯とレシートの有無を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13207-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: After checkout, I carried them home in the same bag. I do not know when they became wet. I have the receipt.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13207-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Explain the carrying history and whether you have a receipt. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13207-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13207-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 状態を担当が確認します。交換や返金についても、確認後の案内になります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13207-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: The staff member will check the condition. Any exchange or refund guidance will also follow that check.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13207-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13207-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: わかりました。食品と洗剤を分けてこのままお渡しするので、両方確認してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13207-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 二つの商品を分けて両方の確認を頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13207-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: Understood. I will separate the food from the detergent and hand them over as they are, so please check both.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13207-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Separate the two products and ask for both to be checked. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13207-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13207-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: それぞれお預かりします。食品の扱いを含め、担当の確認結果をご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13207-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: We will take them separately. We will explain the staff member's findings, including how to handle the food.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13207-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13207-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 散歩の経路をお探しですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13207-08-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you looking for a walking route?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13207-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13207-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい、友達と歩きます。友達も入口に着いたそうです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13207-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 友達が入口に着いたことと散歩の予定を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13207-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes, I will walk with a friend. My friend says they have reached the entrance too.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13207-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say that your friend has reached an entrance and you plan to walk together. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13207-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13207-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: こちらには入口が複数あります。お友達はどの入口にいらっしゃいますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13207-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: There are several entrances here. Which entrance is your friend at?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13207-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13207-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: そこまで聞いていません。同じ入口だと思っていました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13207-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 友達の入口をまだ確認していないと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13207-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: I did not ask that much. I thought it was the same entrance.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13207-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that you have not confirmed your friend's entrance. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13207-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13207-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 歩き始める前に場所を合わせたほうがよさそうですね。電話で確認できますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13207-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: You should probably agree on a place before starting to walk. Can you check by phone?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13207-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13207-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: はい、入口の名前を聞きます。今いるこの入口の名前も教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13207-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 電話で確認するため現在の入口名を聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13207-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: Yes, I will ask the entrance name. Please also tell me the name of this entrance where I am now.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13207-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask your current entrance's name so you can check by phone. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13207-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13207-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: ここは教材の設定では東入口です。お友達はどちらでしたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13207-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: In this learning material's setting, this is the east entrance. Which one was your friend at?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13207-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13207-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 西入口でした。途中ですれ違わないよう、二人が別々に歩き出すのはやめます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13207-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 別々の入口から同時に歩き出さない方針を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13207-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: The west entrance. To avoid passing each other on the way, we will not both start walking separately.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13207-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say that you will not start walking simultaneously from different entrances. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13207-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13207-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: どちらか一人が待つこともできます。どちらで合流しますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13207-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: One of you could also wait. Where will you meet?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13207-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13207-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 友達に西入口で待ってもらい、私がそちらへ行きます。通行できる道と休憩できる場所を教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13207-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 西入口で合流する計画を示して道と休憩場所を聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13207-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will ask my friend to wait at the west entrance and go there myself. Please tell me a usable path and somewhere to rest.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13207-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Give your plan to meet at the west entrance and ask about the path and rest spots. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13207-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13207-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 現在通れる道を案内します。西入口で合流してから、二人で散歩の経路を選んでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13207-08-001-SHARED-11.translation: We will show you a path open now. Meet at the west entrance first, then choose a walking route together.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13208-01-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13208-01-001-SHARED-01.translation: How many people's tickets do you need?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13208-01-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13208-01-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 一人ですが、大きなスーツケースが二つあるので、三枚でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13208-01-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 一人と二つの荷物で三枚必要か聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13208-01-001-SHARED-02.translation: One person, but I have two large suitcases. Does that mean three tickets?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13208-01-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask whether one person and two pieces of luggage require three tickets. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13208-01-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13208-01-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 人の切符と荷物の扱いは別に確認します。お一人で移動されるのですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13208-01-001-SHARED-03.translation: We check passenger tickets separately from luggage handling. You are traveling alone, correct?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13208-01-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13208-01-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: はい、乗るのは私だけです。荷物の分を人として数えていました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13208-01-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 乗車人数は一人だと明確にする。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13208-01-001-SHARED-04.translation: Yes, I am the only passenger. I was counting my luggage as people.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13208-01-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Make clear that there is one passenger. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13208-01-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13208-01-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 目的地と荷物の大きさを教えていただけますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13208-01-001-SHARED-05.translation: Could you tell us your destination and luggage sizes?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13208-01-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13208-01-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 目的地はこちらです。ケースの寸法をメモしたので、持ち込めるか確認してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13208-01-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 目的地と荷物の寸法を示して持込条件を聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13208-01-001-SHARED-06.translation: Here is the destination. I wrote down the case dimensions, so please check whether I can bring them aboard.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13208-01-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Show the destination and luggage dimensions and ask about carry-on conditions. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13208-01-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13208-01-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 担当に条件を確認します。荷物のために空席を使う予定はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13208-01-001-SHARED-07.translation: I will check the conditions with the staff member. Do you intend to use an empty seat for your luggage?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13208-01-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13208-01-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: いいえ、空いていても席に置けるとは考えません。置き場所も案内してほしいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13208-01-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 荷物を座席に置かず置き場所の案内を求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13208-01-001-SHARED-08.translation: No. I do not assume I can put it on a seat even if it is free. I would also like directions about where to place it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13208-01-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ask where to put the luggage without putting it on seats. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13208-01-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13208-01-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 条件によって利用できる列車が変わる可能性があります。希望の出発時刻はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13208-01-001-SHARED-09.translation: The conditions may affect which trains you can take. Do you have a preferred departure time?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13208-01-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13208-01-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 昼ごろが希望です。持ち込み条件がわかってから、一人分の切符を買います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13208-01-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 条件確認後に一人分を購入する方針を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13208-01-001-SHARED-10.translation: Around noon. I will buy a ticket for one person after learning the luggage conditions.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13208-01-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that you will buy for one person after checking the conditions. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13208-01-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13208-01-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 条件と候補列車を確認してご案内します。切符の購入はその後に進めましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13208-01-001-SHARED-11.translation: We will check the conditions and possible trains and explain them. Let us proceed with buying the ticket afterward.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13208-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13208-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 通知のどの部分がわかりませんか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13208-02-001-SHARED-01.translation: Which part of the notice do you not understand?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13208-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13208-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 添付の用紙に知らない人の名前があります。私宛てではないのでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13208-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 添付用紙の知らない名前について相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13208-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: There is an unfamiliar name on the attached form. Does that mean it is not addressed to me?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13208-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask about the unfamiliar name on the attached form. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13208-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13208-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 封筒の宛名と、用紙の上部を確認できますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13208-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: Can you check the envelope addressee and the top of the form?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13208-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13208-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 封筒は私宛てです。用紙の上には小さく「記入例」とあります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13208-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 封筒は本人宛てで用紙には記入例とあることを伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13208-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: The envelope is addressed to me. At the top of the form, it says 'completed example' in small print.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13208-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say that the envelope is addressed to you and the form says completed example. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13208-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13208-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: その紙は書き方を示す見本の可能性があります。ほかに空欄の用紙は入っていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13208-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: That sheet may be a sample showing how to fill it in. Is there another blank form inside?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13208-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13208-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: はい、もう一枚は空欄です。名前のある紙ではなく、そちらに記入するのですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13208-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 別の空欄用紙に記入する理解を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13208-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: Yes, the other sheet is blank. So I should fill in that one rather than the sheet with a name on it, correct?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13208-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Confirm your understanding that you should fill in the separate blank form. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13208-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13208-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 通知の内容と合わせて確認しましょう。どの欄に迷っていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13208-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: Let us check it together with the notice. Which field are you unsure about?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13208-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13208-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 連絡先の欄です。見本の番号を写すのではなく、私に連絡が取れる番号を書くか確認したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13208-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 連絡先に見本の番号を写さず本人の番号を書くか聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13208-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: The contact field. I want to check whether I should write a number where I can be reached rather than copy the sample number.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13208-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ask whether to write your own number rather than copy the sample in the contact field. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13208-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13208-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: ご本人の連絡先を記入する欄か、担当に確認します。原本にはまだ書かないでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13208-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: I will ask the staff member whether it is a field for your own contact details. Please do not write on the original yet.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13208-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13208-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: わかりました。確認後に空欄の用紙へ記入します。見本も捨てずに一緒に持っておきます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13208-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 確認後に記入し見本も保存する方針を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13208-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: Understood. I will fill in the blank form after checking. I will keep the example with it rather than discard it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13208-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that you will fill it in after checking and keep the sample too. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13208-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13208-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 担当へおつなぎします。提出する用紙と手元に残す見本を確認してから進めてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13208-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: I will connect you with the staff member. Please confirm which form to submit and which sample to keep before proceeding.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13208-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13208-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 以前こちらを受診されていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13208-03-001-SHARED-01.translation: Have you been seen here before?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13208-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13208-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 初めてです。名前は田中優です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13208-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 初診であることと名前を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13208-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: This is my first visit. My name is Yu Tanaka.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13208-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: State that this is your first visit and give your name. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13208-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13208-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 同じお名前の記録があります。ご本人の情報と照合してもよろしいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13208-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: There is a record with the same name. May we compare it with your own information?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13208-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13208-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: お願いします。ただ、名前が同じだけで私の記録とは言えないと思います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13208-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 同名だけでは本人の記録と決められないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13208-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: Please do. But I do not think the same name alone means it is my record.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13208-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say that a matching name alone does not establish that it is your record. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13208-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13208-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 生年月日を周囲に聞こえないよう確認しましょう。確認用紙に書いていただけますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13208-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: Let us check your date of birth without others overhearing. Could you write it on the verification sheet?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13208-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13208-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: はい、書きます。ほかの方の住所や病歴は見せなくて大丈夫です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13208-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 本人確認用紙に記入し他人の情報の提示は求めない。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13208-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: Yes, I will. You do not need to show me anyone else's address or medical history.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13208-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Fill in your identity verification sheet without requesting another person's information. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13208-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13208-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。ご本人の記録ではないことを確認しました。初診として受付を進めます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13208-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: Thank you. We have confirmed it is not your record. We will register you as a first-time patient.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13208-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13208-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: わかりました。前の方の診察券番号を使わず、私の受付としてお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13208-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 他人の診察券番号を使わず本人の受付を依頼する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13208-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: Understood. Please register me personally without using the previous person's patient card number.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13208-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ask for your own registration without using someone else's patient card number. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13208-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13208-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: こちらの用紙の連絡先も記入してください。記入が難しい欄はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13208-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please also fill in the contact details on this form. Are any fields difficult to complete?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13208-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13208-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 緊急連絡先は家族に確認してから書きたいです。空欄のまま先に相談してもよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13208-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 家族に未確認の緊急連絡先欄を相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13208-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: I would like to check with my family before writing the emergency contact. May I leave it blank and ask first?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13208-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Ask about the emergency contact field you have not confirmed with family. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13208-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13208-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 受付担当に確認します。ご本人の情報だけで用紙を進め、不明な欄はその場でご相談ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13208-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: I will check with reception. Complete the form using only your own information and ask about unknown fields at the time.
